snippet.title: Perfectly Folded Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Perfectly Folded on Steam! Coming to Steam on November 2, 2026.

Perfectly Folded is a cozy organizing game set in a clothing store the cats have wrecked. Fold, hang and shelve every shirt, hat and shoe, while the cats hide in plain sight as mannequins, dresses and even shelves, and steal clothes right out of your hands. Catch them, and the troublemakers become your coworkers.


Made by Hollow Made, an indie studio in Kaunas, Lithuania. Perfectly Folded is our debut game.
